title: 25 Years Of Brutal Options Trading Advice In 17 Minutes
instrument: single-name options (NVDA used as the worked example), no trade taken
summary: Five 'brutal truths' for beginners: (1) buying options without education puts you at a strategic disadvantage vs sellers; (2) don't buy far-OTM 'lottery ticket' calls; (3) size on max loss and its probability, never on reward; (4) buying into earnings pays for priced-in vol and eats the crush (live NVDA chain the day after its print); (5) theta is steepest near expiry, so sell short-dated and, if buying, buy ~3 months out and exit with ~2 left. Closes with a funnel to the channel's covered-call video.
